title: Hardship Relief Applied to Site-Change Estimates for Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
Hardship relief in the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the hardship approval on the patient's Patient Financial Account — its approved percentage and the date it runs through:

- where the approval runs through the study date or later and its percentage is 50 or more, the copay and the deductible part are added and that sum is reduced by the approved percentage;
- where the approval runs through the study date or later and its percentage is above zero but below 50, only the deductible part is reduced by the approved percentage and the copay is kept whole;
- otherwise nothing is reduced, and the copay and the deductible part are added as they stand.

Each reduced figure is rounded half up to the cent. To reduce an amount by the approved percentage is to multiply it by one hundred less that percentage and divide by 100. The study date is the scheduled date of the study booked against the authorization.

## Worked cases (hypothetical copay of 40.00 and deductible part of 150.00, study on 2026-05-20)

| Hardship approval | Relieved copay and deductible part |
|---|---|
| 60 percent, through 2026-06-30 | the sum 190.00 reduced by 60 percent: 76.00 |
| 50 percent, through 2026-05-20 | the sum 190.00 reduced by 50 percent: 95.00 |
| 30 percent, through 2026-06-30 | copay 40.00 kept whole, plus 150.00 reduced by 30 percent (105.00): 145.00 |
| 60 percent, through 2026-05-19 | ends before the study date — nothing reduced: 190.00 |
| none | nothing reduced: 190.00 |

A further case with rounding: copay 35.00, deductible part 33.33, approval of 25 percent running past the study date. Only the deductible part is reduced: 33.33 reduced by 25 percent is 24.9975, so the copay and the reduced deductible part together come to 59.9975, rounded half up to 60.00.
